Ahmed: Good morning everyone. Today I want us to review the current progress of our online learning platform and plan the next steps for improving user experience. Over the past week, I went through several course sections and noticed that navigation could be confusing for new students. They need a simple way to find lessons, track progress, and resume videos seamlessly. I suggest redesigning the dashboard to highlight enrolled courses, upcoming lessons, and pending assignments. Additionally, we can add a quick overview of recent activity and notifications so users immediately see what's important when they log in. If we focus on these improvements now, we can increase engagement and reduce drop-off rates significantly. I plan to prepare mockups for the new dashboard and send them to the team by Wednesday at 5 p.m. for review. Sara: That's a good point, Sarah. On the technical side, I've been analyzing the backend structure to ensure the platform can handle a growing number of users without performance issues. One critical area is the video streaming service. We need to make sure videos load quickly and resume at the right point even if the user switches devices. I also recommend implementing a progress tracking system that records when students complete lessons, quizzes, or download materials, so instructors can monitor progress efficiently. Additionally, we should add automated notifications for approaching deadlines and incomplete assignments. I will focus on optimizing the backend and preparing a progress tracking API. test and identify any bugs or performance issues that need immediate attention.
